as_told.title: CIA Hollywood liaison Chase Brandon, cousin of Tommy Lee Jones, and Men in Black

plain: Around 1996, a CIA man named Chase Brandon is said to have set up a CIA office in Hollywood to advise filmmakers on stories touching on things like UFOs. The screenwriter Bryce Zabel, who was working in Hollywood at the time, tells Michels that Brandon showed up and opened some kind of CIA operation for advising people on such subjects. Michels adds on a later episode, without naming a source, that Brandon, the official CIA liaison to Hollywood, was a cousin of Tommy Lee Jones, who starred in Men in Black. The point of telling it is that the CIA may have had a hand in how films showed aliens and UFOs.
